news.title: Yenher accepts RM4m insurance settlement over Penang factory fire

recent_en: YENHER accepted a RM4m insurance settlement over the Penang factory fire. The company declared a 1.50 sen per share interim dividend for FY2026, with ex-date on 18 September. The spouse of Executive Director Cheng Mooh Kheng acquired shares in the open market several times in October.
notable_en: The company accepted a RM4m insurance settlement over the Penang factory fire.
The company declared a 1.50 sen per share interim dividend for FY2026.
The spouse of Executive Director Cheng Mooh Kheng acquired shares in the open market.
